handoff_instructions.purpose: Handoffs document the current state and scope of the project so a new LLM session can pick up exactly where the last one left off. They are the primary continuity mechanism for this project.
what_to_include: A summary of what was done, discussed, built, or decided in this session
What worked and what did not work
Current pipeline state — what scripts exist, what their status is, what the next steps are
A condensed recap of prior sessions so the new LLM has full project context without reading every previous handoff
Open questions or blockers that carry into the next session
what_not_to_include: Exhaustive code listings — reference file paths instead
Decisions that were reversed or abandoned mid-session — only document final state
Speculation about distant future work — stay close to what is actually next
format_rules: This handoff_instructions block must appear at the top of every future handoff
When a user says 'create a handoff for this session,' use this block as the template and fill in the session-specific fields
Prior session summaries should be condensed — one paragraph per session, not a full retelling
Be brief but complete. A new LLM should be able to start working immediately after reading this file

this_session.summary: Ran 5 new holdout tests (T15 Mountainside, T16 Lone Fir, T17 Painted Rock, T18 Expo, T19 Settlement MT) in addition to the previously run T14 Solara. Compared all 6 predictions against actual proposals. Identified root causes of failures across all jobs. Agreed on a set of improvements and implemented them all in phase1/inference/m3_infer.py. No tests were re-run yet — that is the first step next session.

m3_infer_improvements_implemented.status: All changes written. Tests NOT yet re-run. Re-run is the first task next session.

added_to_both_PDF_and_IMAGE_prompts: storm_drainage_basin_count (integer|null): Count of discrete drainage basins on grading plan — drives drywell count 1:1
sewer_main_road_coverage_pct (float 0-100|null): % of road corridor with proposed 8" sewer main — drives sewer LF = road_LF × (pct/100)
large_diameter_sewer_main_present (true|false|null): Mirrors existing water main flag — triggers separate 12"+ sewer line item
gemini_prompt_new_fields.sidecar_md_updated: gemini_extract() now writes a 'Drainage / Utility Coverage' section to the .gemini_extraction.md sidecar

system_prompt_changes.before: qty = max(1, round(lot_count × 0.23)). Swale suppression floors at 2.
system_prompt_changes.after: Priority (a): if storm_drainage_basin_count is provided, use it directly (1 basin = 1 drywell). Priority (b): lot_count formula. Swale suppression floor now scales with ROW_SF (small: 2, medium: 3, large: no floor override).

system_prompt_changes.change: Sewer Main LF — coverage pct priority
system_prompt_changes.before: ROW_SF analog scaling as usual; arc_loop gets road_LF × 0.80.
system_prompt_changes.after: Priority (a): sewer_main_road_coverage_pct × road_LF. Priority (b): arc_loop override. Priority (c): ROW_SF analog scaling.

system_prompt_changes.change: Water Main LF — coverage pct priority
system_prompt_changes.after: Priority (a): water_main_road_coverage_pct × road_LF, cross-checked vs formula. Priority (b): formula.

null → stockpile (unchanged behavior). true → only use haul-off if scope_notes has explicit language. CRITICAL: row_stripping_haul_off has 0 KP observations — if confirmed true, price at 3× stockpile median and flag [HAUL-OFF: NO KP DATA ±50%].
Use MEAN of available observations when N < 3. (Max was causing up to 66% over-estimate.)

system_prompt_changes.before: null → omit silently (treated same as false). False → omit.
system_prompt_changes.after: null → include LOT PREP EARTHWORK PLACEHOLDER at lower-bound of portfolio range, flag [LOT GRADING UNCERTAIN — VERIFY WITH BRIAN ±50%]. False → omit. The asymmetry: a false negative ($200K+ miss) is worse than a false positive Brian can remove.

system_prompt_changes.before: No rule existed for sewer main > 8".
system_prompt_changes.after: If large_diameter_sewer_main_present=true, include separate 12"+ sewer main line item. Mirrors the Large-Diameter Water Main rule.

system_prompt_changes.before: No explicit rule. Model omitted it for Lone Fir because it inferred 'no public utilities'.
system_prompt_changes.after: Include if: (a) any water main is in estimate, OR (b) any sewer main is in estimate, OR (c) scope_notes mentions conduit/telecom. Omit ONLY if none of these apply AND job is confirmed no-utility private access.

system_prompt_changes.before: Hardcoded percentages in prompt: '48" SEWER MANHOLE: +7.2%/yr', etc.
system_prompt_changes.after: Instruct Claude to read recency_weight from price_trends in the KP and use the most recent observation when true. No hardcoded numbers. Special cases for 1" WATER SERVICES (volume discount for large jobs) and 8" SEWER MAIN (check recent-3-obs mean vs median).
After Grand Total: compute $/ROW_SF, $/lot, $/road_LF and compare to analog range. Include a sanity check table flagging WARN if outside range.

issues_not_fixed_by_this_session: Lone Fir false-positive utilities: the model will still likely predict sewer/water infrastructure for a job Gemini might classify as a subdivision. Need to verify how Gemini extracted job_type for Lone Fir — if it returned 'private_drive', the new utility trenching rule should suppress sewer/water. If it returned 'subdivision_road', sewer/water will still be predicted.
Painted Rock special paving items (widening, pathway, fire truck turnaround): these require specific plan detection — no rule added for them this session.
Solara ROW_SF extraction failure: Gemini computes road_LF × ROW_width and misses the Meyer Road frontage polygon. The ROW_SF undercount propagates to all scaled items. No fix implemented.
Signs & Striping calibration: the tiered-by-road-classification approach was discussed but not fully implemented. Model still uses analog-scaled value which under-predicts collector roads.

prior_sessions_summary.sessions_2026_6_1_through_2026_6_4.5: Built the full Phase 1 pipeline from scratch: Gemini PDF/image extraction, case library in JSON, knowledge pack derivation (derive_patterns.py), and Claude inference system prompt. Case library has 11 jobs (10 with proposals). KP covers unit price distributions, item pairs, derivation rules, LS earthwork rates, paving rates, qty scale correlations, and price trends.
prior_sessions_summary.session_2026_6_5.1: Tuned m3_infer.py line-item generation — fixed stripping, earthwork, ballast, sewer/water line items.
prior_sessions_summary.session_2026_6_5.2: Built co-occurrence system in KP (item_pairs). Ballast bundled-vs-separate identified as key error source.
prior_sessions_summary.session_2026_6_5.3: Test T7 converged on Killdeer within ±5%. Solara identified as next test.
prior_sessions_summary.session_2026_6_5.4: Killdeer fully converged. Solara $176K ballast false positive surfaced. Architecture rewrite planned.
prior_sessions_summary.session_2026_6_5.5: Architecture streams completed. Fixed Solara case library metrics (ROW_SF, road_LF corrected). KP regen deferred.
prior_sessions_summary.session_2026_6_5.6: Regenerated KP. Killdeer T12 (-4.2%) and T13 (+3.5%) both pass ±5%. Fixed three prompt issues (lot_grading false positive, earthwork_balance disambiguation, EXC TO EMBANK hardcoded floors). Solara T14: $1,666,000 vs $2,388,013 (-30.2%).
prior_sessions_summary.session_2026_6_8.1_this_session: Multi-job validation: ran T15–T19. All 6 jobs (T14–T19) failed ±10% — 0 of 6 passing. Root causes identified: Lone Fir had utilities hallucinated (private drive), Painted Rock had strip haul-off false positive + complex paving missed, Settlement MT had lot grading false negative ($309K miss) + large-diameter mains missed. Implemented 9 changes to m3_infer.py (new Gemini fields, lot grading null flip, haul-off default fix, ballast mean-not-max, utility trenching logic, large-diameter sewer rule, dynamic price trends, post-estimate sanity check). Tests not yet re-run.

open_questions: Lone Fir job_type extraction: Did Gemini return 'private_drive' for Lone Fir? The new utility trenching rule suppresses sewer/water only if the estimate naturally has none — but if the model still generates sewer/water line items for a private drive job, the rules won't stop it. Check the Lone Fir .gemini_extraction.md to confirm job_type.

Solara ROW_SF: Still unresolved. Gemini computes road_LF × ROW_width and misses Meyer Road frontage polygon. Options: (a) CLI --row-sf override, (b) read from qty sheet OTHER2 column via a new extraction step.

Settlement MT proposal ambiguity: The proposal shows $2,267,145.75 as Grand Total with a separate -$100,000 deduct option ('PLACE 16" TOPSOIL INSTEAD OF HAUL OFF') listed below the total. The base total ($2,267,145.75) was used for validation. If the client accepted the deduct, the actual would be $2,167,145.75.

Painted Rock widening paving: 4/4" widening ($53,920) and 3/4" widening ($17,182) plus pathway paving and fire truck turnaround require plan detection. No rule exists for these — they are special items that need Gemini to extract or Claude to infer from scope_notes.
Expo commercial water pricing: 8" WATER MAIN at $102/LF (vs portfolio median $56/LF) is a commercial/short-run premium. The KP median will under-price similar commercial jobs.
Gemini extraction instability: flagged in prior sessions — on re-runs Gemini sometimes extracts different values. No solution implemented.
